sourceAssessment: All 13 records have source-supported Sun Xiu identity anchors in the Sima Lun/Jia crown-prince and usurpation sequence or explicit retrospective references. One record additionally owns a foreign English occurrence and foreign name evidence; that exception is not used as identity proof.

defect.primaryReferent: Li Xiang 李庠, already existing zizhitongjian:083:p150
defect.explanation: s0385 explicitly introduces 李庠 joining 趙廞; s0386 廞以庠 appoints that same Li Xiang. Both English fields instead call him Xiu, and the extraction attaches the English occurrence plus name-evidence unit to Sun Xiu p142. Both fields also call 李庠 Li Xiu at s0385. No claim is made that this false occurrence is Sun Xiu, and no canonical or draft source repair is made here.

value.zh: 外祖平南將軍樂安孫旂，與孫秀善，故秀立之。
value.en: Her maternal grandfather was Sun Qi, General Who Pacifies the South of Le'an, friendly with Xiu, which is why Xiu made her empress.
value.literal: Her maternal grandfather was Sun Qi, General Who Pacifies the South of Le'an, on good terms with Sun Xiu, and therefore Xiu established her.

value.zh: 廞自稱大都督，大將軍、益州牧，署置僚屬，改易守令。
value.en: Xin styled himself Grand Commander-in-Chief, Grand General, and Governor of Yi, appointed staff, and replaced local officials.
value.literal: Xin styled himself Grand Commander-in-Chief, Grand General, and Governor of Yi Province, appointed staff, and changed the garrison commanders and magistrates.

value.en: When court officials were summoned, none dared refuse.
value.literal: When court officials were summoned none dared not go.

value.zh: 李庠帥妹婿李含、天水任回、上官昌、扶風李攀、始平費他、氐苻成、隗伯等四千騎歸廞。
value.en: Li Xiu led Li Han, Ren Hui, Shangguan Chang, Li Pan, Fei Ta, Fu Cheng, Wei Bo, and four thousand horsemen to join Xin.
value.literal: Li Xiu led his brothers-in-law Li Han of Tianshui, Ren Hui, Shangguan Chang, Li Pan of Fufeng, Fei Ta of Shiping, the Di Fu Cheng, and Wei Bo and others with four thousand horsemen to join Xin.

value.zh: 廞以庠為威寇將軍，封陽泉亭侯，委以心膂，使招合六郡壯勇至萬餘人，以斷北道。
value.en: Xin made Xiu General Who Subdues Bandits and Marquis of Yangquan, trusted him deeply, and had him gather more than ten thousand braves of six commanderies to block the northern road.
value.literal: Xin made Xiu General Who Subdues Bandits and Marquis of Yangquan Pavilion, entrusted him as close confidant, and had him gather braves of the six commanderies to more than ten thousand to cut the northern road.
